description: Find products by name, vendor or id, optionally filtered by category, API access level or whether the vendor has an MCP server or AI connector. Returns one row per product; call get_product for the quoted evidence behind each value.

access.description: open = docs and keys self-serve; open-docs-gated-keys = docs public, keys by approval; partner-gated = partnership needed; unknown = no public API found; unreadable = the pages blocked automated reading.

category.description: Category id, e.g. crm, planning, portfolio-reporting, custodian, aggregation. See list_categories.

has_mcp.description: true = only products with an MCP server or AI connector on record.

query.description: Words to match against product name, vendor, id and category. Omit to list all.

name: search_products
title: Search wealth technology products
